# Asteroid Dodge

Control a ship at the bottom of the canvas with left/right arrow keys. Random asteroids fall from the top; colliding with any asteroid ends the game. Survive as long as possible; score is the time survived. Optional power‑ups can grant a temporary shield or speed boost.

1: // Asteroid Dodge game – enhanced graphics
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   // ----- graphics setup -----
6:   // starfield background
7:   const starCount = 80;
8:   const stars = [];
9:   for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
10:     stars.push({
11:       x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
12:       y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
13:       radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
14:       speed: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2,
15:     });
16:   }
17:   function updateStars(delta) {
18:     for (const s of stars) {
19:       s.y += s.speed * delta * 0.05; // scale speed
20:       if (s.y > canvas.height) {
21:         s.y = -s.radius;
22:         s.x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
23:       }
24:     }
25:   }
26:   function drawBackground() {
27:     // space background
28:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
29:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
30:     // stars
31:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
32:     for (const s of stars) {
33:       ctx.beginPath();
34:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
35:       ctx.fill();
36:     }
37:   }
38:   // --------------------------
39: 
40:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
41:   if (!canvas) return; // safety
42:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
43:   // ----- audio setup -----
44:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
45:   function playTone(freq, dur) {
46:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
47:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
48:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
49:     osc.type = 'sine';
50:     osc.connect(gain);
51:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
52:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, audioCtx.currentTime);
53:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
54:     osc.start();
55:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
56:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
57:   }
58:   function playSpawnSound() {
59:     playTone(200, 0.1);
60:   }
61:   function playCollisionSound() {
62:     // descending pitch explosion
63:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
64:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
65:     osc.type = 'triangle';
66:     osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(300, audioCtx.currentTime);
67:     osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(50, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.3);
68:     osc.connect(gain);
69:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
70:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.3, audioCtx.currentTime);
71:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.3);
72:     osc.start();
73:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.3);
74:   }
75:   // --------------------------
76: 
77:   // ----- configuration -----
78:   const shipWidth = 40;
79:   const shipHeight = 20;
80:   const shipSpeed = 5;
81:   const asteroidSize = 30;
82:   const asteroidMinSpeed = 2;
83:   const asteroidMaxSpeed = 5;
84:   const spawnInterval = 1000; // ms
85:   // --------------------------
86: 
87:   const ship = {
88:     x: canvas.width / 2 - shipWidth / 2,
89:     y: canvas.height - shipHeight - 10,
90:     width: shipWidth,
91:     height: shipHeight,
92:     dx: 0,
93:     draw() {
94:       // ship as pointed triangle
95:       ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
96:       ctx.beginPath();
97:       ctx.moveTo(this.x, this.y + this.height);
98:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.width / 2, this.y);
99:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.width, this.y + this.height);
100:       ctx.closePath();
101:       ctx.fill();
102:     },
103:     update() {
104:       this.x += this.dx;
105:       // keep inside canvas
106:       if (this.x < 0) this.x = 0;
107:       if (this.x + this.width > canvas.width) this.x = canvas.width - this.width;
108:     },
109:   };
110: 
111:   const asteroids = [];
112: 
113:   function spawnAsteroid() {
114:     playSpawnSound();
115:     const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - asteroidSize);
116:     const speed = asteroidMinSpeed + Math.random() * (asteroidMaxSpeed - asteroidMinSpeed);
117:     asteroids.push({ x, y: -asteroidSize, size: asteroidSize, speed });
118:   }
119: 
120:   function updateAsteroids(delta) {
121:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
122:       const a = asteroids[i];
123:       a.y += a.speed;
124:       if (a.y > canvas.height) {
125:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
126:       }
127:     }
128:   }
129: 
130:   function drawAsteroids() {
131:     for (const a of asteroids) {
132:       const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(
133:         a.x + a.size / 2,
134:         a.y + a.size / 2,
135:         a.size * 0.1,
136:         a.x + a.size / 2,
137:         a.y + a.size / 2,
138:         a.size / 2
139:       );
140:       gradient.addColorStop(0, '#aaa');
141:       gradient.addColorStop(1, '#555');
142:       ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
143:       ctx.beginPath();
144:       ctx.arc(a.x + a.size / 2, a.y + a.size / 2, a.size / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
145:       ctx.fill();
146:     }
147:   }
148: 
149:   function checkCollision() {
150:     for (const a of asteroids) {
151:       if (
152:         ship.x < a.x + a.size &&
153:         ship.x + ship.width > a.x &&
154:         ship.y < a.y + a.size &&
155:         ship.y + ship.height > a.y
156:       ) {
157:         return true;
158:       }
159:     }
160:     return false;
161:   }
162: 
163:   let lastTime = performance.now();
164:   let lastSpawn = performance.now();
165:   let running = true;
166:   let score = 0;
167: 
168:   function loop(now) {
169:     // update moving background stars
170:     updateStars(now - lastTime);
171:     const delta = now - lastTime;
172:     lastTime = now;
173:     if (!running) {
174:       // show final score
175:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
176:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
177:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
178:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
179:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
180:       ctx.fillText(`Game Over – Score: ${Math.floor(score / 1000)}s`, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
181:       return;
182:     }
183: 
184:     // spawn asteroids
185:     if (now - lastSpawn > spawnInterval) {
186:       spawnAsteroid();
187:       lastSpawn = now;
188:     }
189: 
190:     // update
191:     ship.update();
192:     updateAsteroids(delta);
193:     if (checkCollision()) {
194:       playCollisionSound();
195:       running = false;
196:     }
197: 
198:     // draw
199:     // draw moving starfield background
200:     drawBackground();
201:     ship.draw();
202:     drawAsteroids();
203: 
204:     // score – time survived in ms
205:     score += delta;
206:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
207:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
208:     ctx.textAlign = 'left';
209:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${Math.floor(score / 1000)}s`, 10, 20);
210: 
211:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
212:   }
213: 
214:   // input handling
215:   document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
216:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') ship.dx = -shipSpeed;
217:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') ship.dx = shipSpeed;
218:   });
219:   document.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
220:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowRight') ship.dx = 0;
221:   });
222: 
223:   // start loop
224:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
225: })();
